_about: The fit score's settings (FIT_SETTINGS, default apply/fit-settings.json); a key left out keeps its default. weights: a requirement's weight by its place in the posting (title: the skill in the job title; must_years: a must-have that asks years; must: another must-have; nice: a nice-to-have). grades: the lowest score of each band (under long_shot: weak). channel_notes: a note per place, added to the fit's reason line; it never changes the grade. Made-up example.

channel_notes.Springfield: board applications here get few replies; a referral or a recruiter works better
